content: Open Music Theory documents reusable harmonic schemas rather than exhaustive song recipes: ii-V-I is foundational in jazz; basic twelve-bar blues centers I, IV, and V with common turnaround variants; pop uses recurring four-chord and blues-derived schemas. These conventions are suitable seed families, but mapping them to J-6 banks still requires bank-by-bank musical audition because many banks use substitutions, inversions, repeated pads, or nonfunctional sonorities.
